name: Mikaeus + Triskelion
explanation: With both on the battlefield, use Triskelion counters to deal damage and kill itself; undying returns it with a +1/+1 counter. Remove all counters before its next death to repeat. Can deal arbitrary damage, assuming legal targets and no prevention or replacement effects. Opponents may interact.

name: Heliod + Walking Ballista
explanation: Ballista needs at least two +1/+1 counters and lifelink granted by Heliod (costs 1W). Remove a counter to damage an opponent; lifelink gains life and Heliod replaces the counter. Repeat for arbitrary damage absent prevention or interaction. Presence in a deck does not establish an executable win.
